sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In 'Wedding Planner', the core gameplay revolves around planning and managing the wedding. You'll start by choosing the wedding theme, decorations, and flowers. Next, you'll need to assign tasks to your team of helpers, including the chef, florist, musician, and photographer. Each task has a specific time limit, and you'll need to manage your resources effectively to ensure that everything is completed on time. As you progress through the levels, the tasks become increasingly challenging, and you'll need to make strategic decisions to optimize your workflow and maximize your rewards.

The game features a variety of wedding planning tasks, including decorating the venue, creating the wedding menu, selecting the wedding Cake, and assigning the wedding dress to the bride. You'll also need to manage the budget, as there are limited funds available for each level. The game's objective is to complete the wedding planning tasks within the given time limit, while also earning rewards and bonuses for achieving specific goals. With its engaging gameplay and challenging objectives, 'Wedding Planner' is an excellent choice for players seeking a fun and rewarding experience.

The game's resource management system is intuitive and easy to understand, making it accessible to players of all skill levels.
